prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent background RGBA VFX key drawing of ELECTRICAL LIGHTNING, frame 1 of a 3-drawing electricity animation. The supplied reference is style only: extract its SHARP jagged branching lightning visual language, absolutely no character or scene. Only bright white-hot lightning with lemon-yellow aura, genuine transparent background. Main silhouette: irregular shattered angular electric branches spreading outward from a contact point at canvas center (50%,60%), composition wider than tall. Three main jagged branches with knife-sharp white triangular cores and many thread-thin erratic arcs. Vary thickness abruptly from hair thin to occasional broad spear tips. Broken sharp angular outlines and pointed shards, not smooth wavy contours. Soft translucent golden bloom very close to each line, lots of fully clear space between branches. NO FIRE, NO FLAMES, NO SMOKE, NO LIQUID, NO FEATHERS, NO SWIRLING PETALS, NO ROUNDED HOOKS, NO symmetrical radial star, NO constant-width zigzag pipes. Anime hand-inked electrical discharge, not a golden explosion cloud. No background, no black matte, no checkerboard art, no text. All line tips and glow must taper fully inside generous 12% transparent margins.
